content: Kavya Iyer called insurance agent Neha Kapoor to confirm the cancellation of her health policy (HP-DC-2024-5678). Neha confirmed the cancellation was processed, explained that coverage remains active until the end of the day on 30 September 2026, and stated that the $120 December premium will be prorated and refunded within 7 to 10 business days. Neha also noted that no paperwork is required and that Kavya can apply for a new policy in the future if she changes her mind.

action_items: Send final confirmation email to customer
Process prorated refund of $120 within 7-10 business days
